# SQL join grain: source and evidence outline

This is the source-only assembly outline for [RecallWeave #276](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/RecallWeave/issues/276). Its initial version was frozen at **2026-10-09 14:18:21 UTC**; this revision adds the subsequently received root source-review record and makes that update explicit at **2026-10-09 14:20:49 UTC**. The original course, worked guide and worksheet are sealed, and the questions-only independent source derivation agrees with the authored solutions. **Actual SQL qualification, physical delivery and original-parser qualification are pending in this outline.** No candidate commit or receiving ref has been created.

## Course files

- [Course JSON](../../../courses/sql-join-grain.json) contains twelve original questions and four concepts.
- [Worked guide](../../../courses/sql-join-grain.md) contains the complete fictional data, all query texts, full expected outputs, explanations, transfers and the quantified policy proof.
- [Plain SQL worksheet](../../../courses/sql-join-grain.sql) contains the setup and twelve exact queries for an existing SQLite environment.

The lesson follows what one row represents as two independent child relations are joined to a parent. It covers multiplied counts and sums, value distinctness versus record identity, final output distinctness, grouping each child before joining, existence-based qualification, unequal weighting of averages, and a sufficient condition that holds across the declared finite domain. The existing learner's lesson-file format remains the intended JSON interface.

The course, guide and worksheet preserve their original seals. Their source semantics target remains SQLite 3.50.4. The separate runtime amendment describes a prospective qualification on the actually observed Python 3.14.4 / SQLite 3.46.1 environment; that amendment is not an executed result.

## Qualification state

| Evidence | State in this outline | Exact record |
|---|---|---|
| Original question and author seals | Complete; unchanged after disclosure | [Initial chronology](author/INITIAL-CHRONOLOGY.json), [disclosure chronology](author/DISCLOSURE-CHRONOLOGY.json) |
| Questions-only independent authority | Complete source derivation before authored solution exposure | [Original questions](author/QUESTIONS-ONLY.json), [root authority](root/INDEPENDENT-SOURCE-AUTHORITY.json) |
| Producer's full literal comparison | Zero source discrepancies across twelve queries, 48 option identities, 36 expected rows and 91 typed cells | [Comparison](author/SOURCE-COMPARISON.json), [original authored key](author/EXPECTED-PRIVATE.json) |
| Root post-disclosure source review | Complete source comparison; zero discrepancies; original in-memory review and later artifact upload are distinguished | [Root source review](root/ROOT-POST-DISCLOSURE-SOURCE-REVIEW.json) |
| Existing ThinkPad runtime metadata | One actual closed metadata intake; no SQL or parser invocation | [Runtime report](runtime/README.md), [native receipt](runtime/NATIVE-RECEIPT.json), [effective closure](runtime/CLOSURE-OBSERVATION.json) |
| Root runtime review and amendment | Actual source records; future execution remains separately gated | [Metadata review](root/ROOT-ACTUAL-THINKPAD-METADATA-REVIEW.json), [prospective amendment](root/ROOT-PROSPECTIVE-RUNTIME-AMENDMENT.json) |
| Independent SQLite qualification | Pending; no actual SQL receipt is represented here | Reserved future evidence only |
| Physical delivery and original parser | Source proposal complete; native operation pending | [Delivery plan](delivery-proposal/PLAN.json), [proposal custody](delivery-proposal/PROPOSAL-CUSTODY.json) |
| Learner session, browser and study-notes download | Outside this proposed delivery/parser step | No such result is claimed |
| Final source composition/publication | Pending root review and later trigger/ref checks | No candidate commit/ref exists |

The two independently chosen Q12 counterexamples are both retained. They use different valid data to refute the same three insufficient conditions. This is not a discrepancy in the fixed worksheet fixture, and neither counterexample is represented as a separately executed query.

## Original source, scope and chronology

[Source custody](SOURCE-CUSTODY.json) maps the three maintained files, original private key, complete questions, original seals, disclosure chronology, independent authority and initial comparison. [Original intake custody](intake/CUSTODY.json) preserves the full selected title/body snapshots for 274 project issues/PRs and 53 bounded central comments, plus the later project window and actual reservation. Those bounded public records do not claim a complete native ownership or lease census.

Private drafting began before the questions-only handoff. The questions text was sealed at 13:28:12 UTC and all four authored materials at 13:34:32 UTC. Root's independent authority was frozen at 13:42:31 UTC before the authored answer/guide/key/source handles were disclosed. The source files have not changed after that disclosure.

The existing SQL foundations, transactions, windows, functional-dependency, foreign-key, recursive-query, serializability and SQL NULL lesson owners remain intact. Existing importer, combined-output, learner, catalog and workflow scopes are preserved. The only maintained additions are the three `courses/sql-join-grain` paths; evidence stays under this unique receiving directory.

## Runtime history and its limits

[Runtime custody](runtime/PORTABLE-CUSTODY.json) retains the entire original proposal, actual tool records, exact native stdout, version-child streams and actual closure. The single metadata operation observed Python 3.14.4, SQLite 3.46.1 and Node 22.22.1. It made no SQL connection or statement and invoked no course parser or application.

The original [intake source](runtime/retained/intake-v1.py), its [exact source revision](runtime/SOURCE-REVISION.json), the original [derived closure observation](runtime/retained/CLOSURE-OBSERVATION-v1.json), and the effective closure remain separate. The derived Node stdout count was corrected from eight to nine bytes using the unchanged original text and hexadecimal stream. No native operation was repeated.

The executable/module hashes in the actual metadata receipt identify measured native files; the executable bodies were not exported. The Node observation covers its `/usr/bin/node` ELF wrapper and reported version, without qualifying its complete shared-library closure. The recorded disk/effective-memory observations are point-in-time evidence, not a future capacity reservation or proof that a new destination is writable.

## Proposed minimal physical delivery

The source proposal names one exclusive ordinary target:

`/home/jacob/recallweave-sql-join-grain-c945953fdeb7`

It would create exactly the three unchanged course files and a final `DELIVERY.json`. It independently checks the existing parent and new target, rechecks the observed Python/Node executable identities, and applies four fresh 2 GiB disk/effective-memory guards. The physical file budget is 256 KiB of logical file bytes.

The [parser wrapper](delivery-proposal/admit-lesson.mjs) would import the exact original [RecallWeave parser source](../../../src/deck.mjs) through a data URL and call `parseDeck` once on the saved JSON. It compares all returned content fields, the twelve IDs, four concepts and title. The [stage source](delivery-proposal/stage-lesson.py), [exact input](delivery-proposal/STAGING-INPUT.json) and [fully quoted command](delivery-proposal/START-REQUEST.json) remain prospective.

[Exact source deltas](delivery-proposal/EXACT-SOURCE-DELTAS.json) reconstruct the new sources from the previous received approach in both directions. The previous [stage source](delivery-proposal/retained/previous-stage-lesson.py) and [parser wrapper](delivery-proposal/retained/previous-admit-lesson.mjs) are retained as historical inputs. The original ESM parser itself is unchanged; the prior wrapper's only substitutions are the new observed Node version and course title.

The one parser child has an eight-second communicate timeout. The matching actual outer completion must also meet the 20-second external runtime bound. The plan discloses the inherited pre-output alarm cancellation, post-capture stream checks and absence of a hard RSS cap. A refusal preserves partial files and stops that attempt.

### Guide navigation in the two contexts

In the eventual repository layout, all of the guide's relative links resolve to inherited source or these three additions. In the proposed minimal native copy, the course JSON and SQL links would resolve locally. The optional foundations, demo and README links require repository context; the planned final marker records their exact pinned source URLs. It does not create an application entrypoint.

[Navigation evidence](assembly/NAVIGATION.json) records each relative link and its resolution, including these explicitly disclosed native-context exceptions. Archived issue-body/source strings keep their original context and bytes.

## Planned source assembly and inherited files

The latest [main/ref/workflow snapshot](assembly/CURRENT-REF-WORKFLOW-INTAKE.json) observes main at `ec07bf3989132130759e5c00c6cb02eef19709d3`, unchanged from the qualified source parent. The proposed receiving-ref prefix is absent. All five current workflow bodies match their earlier exact pins.

[Complete parent leaves](assembly/PARENT-LEAVES.json) identifies all 2,933 inherited files by exact path, mode, type, Git identity and byte count. [Assembly plan](assembly/ASSEMBLY-PLAN.json) requires every inherited leaf to remain exact and adds only the three course paths and this evidence prefix. It retains any legitimate later parent advance for root review instead of resetting other work.

[Available custody](assembly/AVAILABLE-CUSTODY.json) maps only objects that actually exist and have been read back. It does not represent reserved future evidence as existing files.

## Reserved future evidence

The assembly plan reserves `independent-sql/` for the eventual complete independent SQL source/input/actual-result packet, `delivery-actual/` for an admitted physical delivery/parser receipt and exact transport, and additional `root/` records for actual source/native/final-tree reviews. No files, counts, hashes, exit codes or pass claims are invented for those reservations.

There is no candidate tree, commit or ref in this source-only outline. Root retains any eventual source-ref publication decision and fresh checks for tracked and managed Actions pathways. No PR, main, workflow or Actions operation is admitted by this document.

## Use the lesson

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [Course JSON](../../../courses/sql-join-grain.json) | Twelve self-contained questions in RecallWeave's original course format; four concepts and four options per item. |

The lesson addresses two independent child collections joined to one parent. In its fixture, Atlas has three sessions of 30, 30 and 15 minutes and two reviews. The joined pairs repeat the true 75-minute session total to 150. SUM(DISTINCT minutes) produces 45 because equal values are not the same as equal record identities. The questions then distinguish identity-preserving projection, separate child rollups, existence checks and a sufficient join-cardinality rule.
